newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Enviroserv holds yr shr steady, waives div.
newsitem.headline: Enviroserv holds yr shr steady, waives div.

text.p: NOTE - Enviroserv said that because it was in the process of implementing an issue of shares for cash, with selected financial institutions, to reduce the current level of borrowings, the directors had resolved to pass the final dividend.
The company said that a key factor in determining the pace at which earnings would increase was the speed at which the acquired business was consolidated.

Enviroserv said on Monday it had bought 100 percent of Waste-Tech from Fraser Alexander and its management in a deal worth 189 million rand. The acquisition was effective January 1 1997 and would be settled by the issue of 45.1 million Enviroserv shares, representing 45 percent of the enlarged Enviroserv's issued share capital, the company said in a statement.
